sites.name: Amazon fulfillment center (Tradepoint Atlantic #1)
sites.note: 855K SF building, opened 2018, 1,500+ associates. A hiring.amazon.com posting lists the work address as '6001 Bethlehem Blvd 1S32'. The 2022 code sheet lists codes BFN1 and DCA6 at this address; the facility's primary FC code is not confirmed. It is not MTN1, which is in Wilmington DE.

sites.name: Amazon fulfillment center BWI2 (Broening Hwy)
sites.note: A 2022 code sheet lists BWI2 as an FC and BWI0 (Small Sortable) at the same address. No closure appears in the MD WARN logs for 2023-2026. Large site with about 1,000+ jobs at opening.

sites.name: Amazon sort center BWI5 (Holabird Ave)
sites.note: 345K SF, permitted 2014. A hiring.amazon.com sort-center posting lists the work address as '5501 Holabird Ave 1560'. The code sheet labels BWI5 as SC.

sites.name: Amazon site (5300 Holabird Ave)
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (5300 HOLABIRD AVE, BALTIMORE, MD, 21224)
sites.note: Comes only from the 2022 code sheet, with no type label. A 2020 Patch article says Amazon had TWO sortation centers in Baltimore City, and this could be the second one. Not confirmed.

sites.name: Amazon delivery station (Van Deman St)
sites.note: 72K SF, opened Sept 2021 as the first delivery station in Baltimore City. Facility code unknown. No closure notice found.

sites.name: Amazon delivery station (Preston Gateway, Hanover)
sites.note: 194K SF, opened Sept 2021 as Amazon's 3rd delivery station in Hanover. The Oct 2022 Hanover closure was a different building (7458 New Ridge Rd, per the WARN notice), so this station was NOT the one closed. Facility code unknown.

sites.name: Former Amazon delivery station (New Ridge Rd, Hanover)
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (7458 NEW RIDGE RD, HANOVER, MD, 21076)
sites.note: Closed Oct 25, 2022, with 190 layoffs. The 154K SF building is part of the Techwood @ BWI park that Amazon bought in Mar 2020 for $90.5M; other buildings in that park may still be Amazon-owned, use unknown.

sites.name: Former Amazon delivery station (Kelso Dr, Essex)
sites.note: Closed Oct 25, 2022, with 163 layoffs. 272.5K SF.

sites.name: Amazon SMD1 (Dorsey Run Rd, Elkridge)
sites.note: Listed on warehouse.ninja and the 2022 code sheet. An S-prefix usually means a Sub-Same-Day site, so this may be a same-day fulfillment or delivery hybrid. Type and current status not confirmed.

sites.name: Amazon delivery station DLD1 (Solley Rd, Glen Burnie)
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (7659 SOLLEY RD, GLEN BURNIE, MD, 21060)
sites.note: 340K SF lease reported Oct 2020, plus an adjacent parking parcel. Amazon announced a Glen Burnie last-mile station in July 2020. Likely operating, but current status not confirmed.

sites.name: Amazon sort center (Aberdeen)
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (913 OLD PHILADELPHIA RD, ABERDEEN, MD, 21001)
sites.note: About 300K SF former Pier 1 DC, opened Nov 2020 with 1,000+ jobs. A hiring.amazon.com sort-center posting lists '913 Old Philadelphia Road 3G12'. About 46 km from downtown.

sites.name: Amazon site DMD2 (Lakeside Blvd, Edgewood)
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (2203 LAKESIDE BLVD, EDGEWOOD, MD, 21040)
sites.note: Comes only from the 2022 code sheet. May be an earlier or temporary Edgewood station. Status not confirmed.

sites.name: Amazon site MTN9 (Nottingham / White Marsh)
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (5300 NOTTINGHAM DR, NOTTINGHAM, MD, 21236)
sites.note: The 2022 code sheet labels MTN9 here as 'FC'. A Nov 2020 Patch article mentions Amazon hiring for a 'White Marsh sort center'. Type and status not confirmed.

sites.name: Amazon site HBA3 (North Point Rd)
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (817 N NORTH POINT RD, BALTIMORE, MD, 21237)
sites.note: Comes only from the 2022 code sheet. Facility type unknown (H-prefix); 'delivery_station' is a placeholder. The street name may be North Point Blvd/Rd. Treat as low confidence.

sites.name: Amazon delivery station DLD7 (Lanham)
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (10100 WILLOWDALE RD, LANHAM, MD, 20706)
sites.note: 90K SF, launched Feb 2021. About 42 km from downtown Baltimore, near the edge of the radius.

sites.name: Amazon delivery station DMD9 (Upper Marlboro)
sites.address: 1000 Prince George's Blvd, Upper Marlboro, MD 20774
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (1000 PRINCE GEORGES BLVD, UPPER MARLBORO, MD, 20774)
sites.note: Approved by the PG County Council Oct 2020 and reported operating Nov 2021 (Patch). The MD Supreme Court ruled for Amazon in a 2023 neighbor dispute. About 49 km away, near the edge of the radius. 'Open' is based on 2021-2023 reporting.

sites.name: Amazon delivery station DDC2 (Rockville)
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (861 E GUDE DR, ROCKVILLE, MD, 20850)
sites.note: About 51 km away, at the edge of the radius. Listed as a delivery station; current status not confirmed.

sites.name: Amazon site SDC2 (Silver Spring)
sites.address: 2 University Blvd W, Silver Spring, MD 20901
sites.coordinateSource: U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (2 UNIVERSITY BLVD W, SILVER SPRING, MD, 20901)
sites.note: Comes only from the 2022 code sheet; S-prefix (sub-same-day?). About 45 km away. Type and status unknown.
